title: FMutate layout
description: One layout for one firmware. Positions are in cells of the authoring grid (grid.cols × grid.rows); renderers scale to the device grid.

firmware.description: Which firmware this layout is for. 'any' layouts only use universal bindings.

grid.description: The grid this layout was authored on.

dock.description: Controls drawn at the same cells on every page. Page controls must not overlap them.

made_by.description: 'app' = written by a sibling app over distribution.

jump.description: CC only: slider jumps to touch position.

on.description: CC on a button: the value sent while pressed or toggled on.

off.description: CC on a button: the value sent on release or toggle off, unless a control of this layout last set this CC (then that value comes back).

action.description: bend: while on, keyboard strips bend instead of glissando (as glide = wobble).

binding.description: What a control (or one axis/gesture of it) drives.

on.description: A motion control's gestures: x (tilt X, roll), y (tilt Y, pitch), twist (gyroscope yaw) are values; shake and near (proximity) are presses.

midi_in.description: A hardware MIDI control learned onto this control's gesture (MIDI learn): matching messages drive the control as touching it would, and no longer take their default path (notes to keys, the rest to the firmware's MIDI in).

on.description: value: knob, slider. x, y: XY pad axes. press: button, key, label, a pad.

number.description: The CC, the note (note, poly_pressure) or the program; absent for pitch_bend and channel_pressure.

device.description: The MIDI source's name as FMutate lists it (a device's name, plus ' · port N' past its first port; 'FMutate A' for apps playing into the virtual port). Absent: any device.

mode.description: CC on a value gesture: absolute (0..127 is the value; encoders get clicks from its change) or an endless encoder's coding: 64 ± n, two's complement (1 up, 127 down), sign bit (1 up, 65 down).

type.description: 'menu' is the creature button. Every layout has exactly one, in the dock; if missing, the renderer adds it at the first free cell from the top-left. 'motion' drives its bindings from the phone's motion sensors while engaged.

midi_in.description: Learned MIDI inputs, at most one per gesture. A pad grid's are on its pads.

keyboard.description: type = keyboard. Range is in firmware keys (0..26) plus octave arrows.

bend_range.description: Semitones at half a key width of sideways slide; assumes the firmware's own bend range is ±2 (OberVave and ShineOn factory programs).

velocity.description: fixed: firmware key presses at the firmware's own velocity (as the hardware). position: MIDI notes, velocity from where the key is struck (front edge = max, back = min); octave is the strip's own.

swell.description: position only, opt-in: sliding front/back on a held key sets MIDI CC7 (volume), the same front = max, back = min. CC7 is the firmware's whole volume, so every sounding note swells together (a note's own velocity is fixed once it starts).

pressure.description: position only, opt-in, for firmwares that take MIDI polyphonic aftertouch as a note's level (FMutate's OberVave): the held note's own level follows the finger, full at the key's front edge, silent at its back edge. Takes precedence over swell.

scale.description: e.g. 'chromatic', 'D dorian'. Non-chromatic hides out-of-scale keys.

pad_grid.description: type = pad_grid. Pads listed left→right, top→bottom; each has its own bindings.

motion.description: type = motion. Sensors are read only while the control is engaged.

engage.description: hold: active only while a finger is on the tile, values move relative to the orientation at touch-down. latch: a tap turns it on, another tap off.

range.description: Degrees of tilt (or twist) that sweep a value's whole span; pitch bend goes centre→end in half of it.

on_release.description: On disengage values stay, or spring back to where they were at engage (encoders get the reverse clicks).

shake.description: Shake threshold: 0.6 / 1.2 / 2.0 g of acceleration beyond gravity.

strum.description: Strings map to firmware keys, low at the bottom.

scale.description: Pixel-exact: the largest whole multiple of 240 device pixels that fits, up to this. Absent: fill (the largest square that fits the cells, sharp-scaled).
